name: Shreeyansh
player_statement:
A complete player, Shreeyansh has made a big mark in cricket. With 14 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 36*, with an average of 8.45 and a quick strike rate of 83.04. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 5 sixes and 7 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 18.1 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 4.73. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
